subject: Entitlement reconciliation & delivery plan for SOC 2 / SIG intake
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@veritas-security.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: controls@medivance.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask: scoped entitlement snapshot for SOC 2 + SIG

Naomi —

Thanks for the quick intake call today. For the SOC 2 / SIG evidence package we need a scoped snapshot of accounts and entitlements for the past 90 days focused on high-privilege roles and machine/service accounts. Specifically we need: 

- A CSV extract of accounts with role assignments and owner (include service accounts flagged)
- SCIM delta samples for any sync windows that included role changes (we only need samples, not full logs)
- Examples of SAML assertions showing the nameID / attributes used for group/role mapping
- A one-page attestation from your IAM/product team describing least-privilege enforcement and role review cadence

Can you confirm deliverables and ETA? We have a controls review starting 11/24 so a delivery by 11/19 would be ideal.

Thanks,
Sam Park
Senior Auditor, Veritas Security
--
Veritas Security | sam.park@veritas-security.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@veritas-security.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: scoped entitlement snapshot for SOC 2 + SIG

Sam —

Thanks, confirmed. We're able to provide the requested items. To manage risk and reduce PII exposure we'll deliver a scoped bundle limited to: 

- All users and service accounts with any of these roles in the last 90 days: Owner, Admin, BillingAdmin, SSO-Admin, Service-Account-Admin, and any custom role tagged "privileged"
- A sample of SCIM deltas (three delta files covering major syncs between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-15)
- Two SAML assertion examples (one interactive login, one automated service-to-service) with non-sensitive attribute redaction
- Attestation PDF signed by IAM and Product (I will coordinate)

I'll attach a short delivery plan and list of filenames. ETA: 11/19 EOD PST. If that aligns I'll start internal coordination and pull the extracts.

Attachments: entitlement-recon-plan.pdf (scope + file list)

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Entitlement extract + attestation workback (Medivance SOC2/SIG)

Team —

Per the intake from Veritas/Medivance: they want a scoped entitlements deliverable by 11/19 EOD PST. I attached the plan to the external reply but pasting the key asks below. Please keep this thread internal until we confirm the redaction approach.

Deliverables we need to produce (high level):
1) privileged-entitlements-20261116.csv — export of all accounts that held any privileged role in the last 90 days. Columns: account_id, principal_type (user/service), display_name, email, roles (semicolon-delimited), role_assigned_at, role_revoked_at, owner_name, owner_email, last_login, notes
2) scim-delta-sample-*.zip — three delta snapshots (we only need the diffs for role changes)
3) saml-assertion-examples.txt — two assertion dumps with attribute redaction (mask emails to user@***.com)
4) entitlement attestation — one-page signed statement from IAM/Product describing role reviews and enforcement cadence

Jonas — can you run the export and produce the CSV + two delta files by EOD 11/18 so Irene can vet the redaction and owners column? Put the CSV in the compliance bucket and share link.
Irene — can you draft the attestation language and review the SAML assertion redaction guidelines? I put a short table below for owners to fill:

Mutual action plan (brief)
- 11/16: intake confirmed (done)
- 11/18 EOD: exports completed (Jonas)
- 11/19 AM: redaction & attestation reviewed (Irene)
- 11/19 EOD: bundle packaged and uploaded (Naomi)

Let me know blockers.

Naomi
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Entitlement extract + attestation workback (Medivance SOC2/SIG)

Naomi / Irene —

I've run the entitlement export against the last 90 days and scrubbed PII per our compliance checklist. The CSV is staged in gs://redwood-compliance/medivance/privileged-entitlements-20261116.csv (I attached a local copy to this thread). Also included two SCIM delta samples: scim-delta-sample-20261112.json.gz and scim-delta-sample-20261103.json.gz (zipped in scim-delta-sample-20261115.zip).

Notes on the CSV:
- Service accounts are flagged in principal_type and service accounts with long-lived keys include a notes column with key rotation age
- role_revoked_at is null if assignment is still active
- Owner resolution is best-effort; I added owner_email where resolvable and left placeholder "owner@unknown" when not

Irene — I redacted emails to user@***.com in the SAML samples and left the attribute names intact so Sam can validate mapping (See saml-assertion-examples.txt stub).

If we need additional deltas I can pull a third snapshot but these two cover the major syncs.

Jonas
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@veritas-security.com>
Cc: controls@medivance.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Entitlement bundle delivery — Medivance SOC 2 / SIG (attachments)

Sam —

Per the plan, attached is the scoped entitlement bundle for Medivance: 
- privileged-entitlements-20261116.csv (export, PII redacted where appropriate)
- scim-delta-sample-20261115.zip (three delta snapshots, role-change diffs)
- saml-assertion-examples.txt (two examples with redaction)
- entitlement-recon-plan.pdf (scope and delivery checklist)
- Attestation: attestation_ioc_iam_signed.pdf (signed by Irene Choi, IAM Product Lead)

A few caveats / clarifications:
- Owner resolution: where owner_email is "owner@unknown" we do not have a canonical owner in the provisioning system; we included notes indicating the last-known approver where possible.
- Service account keys: key age is in notes; we recommend a follow-up if Medivance needs per-key evidence.

If you need an unredacted view for audit review under an NDA, let me know the preferred mechanism and we'll coordinate with Legal.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: privileged-entitlements-20261116.csv (CSV), scim-delta-sample-20261115.zip (ZIP), saml-assertion-examples.txt (TXT), entitlement-recon-plan.pdf (PDF), attestation_ioc_iam_signed.pdf (PDF)
